versions.text: Criterion: Verify that all air vehicle configurations have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 4.1.3.4 Determining air vehicle configurations. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.1.7 Configurations. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
